title: StockSmart Demand Planning Table — Uneven and Volatile VendPoint Months in a Consigned Bin's Daily Usage
content:
**Scope.** The reorder point of a new consigned StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program bin that takes over an item taken out of one of the customer's VendPoint Industrial Vending Program machines rests on a daily usage. Where the item's months at that machine are uneven, the daily usage is sized up.

**Months.** A row's age in whole months is the number of calendar months from its date to today, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than the row's day of the month; the latest, middle and earliest month hold rows of age zero, one and two (the last 3 months). Each month's figure is the item's net vends at the machine of the customer's most recent requested removal of it: units vended there less units returned to it and units credited there as vend errors.

**Rule.** Where the transferred item had net vends in each of the latest, middle and earliest month and its highest of those months is 1.4 times its lowest or more, its daily usage is its highest month divided by 30; where it had net vends in each of those months and its highest month is 1.15 times its lowest or more but less than 1.4 times, its daily usage is a blend: its highest month and one third of its net vends of the last three months (the three-month total divided by 3) are added together, the sum is halved (0.5 times), and the result is divided by 30. Any other item, including one with a month without net vends, is not re-sized under this table.

| Earliest, middle, latest (hypothetical units) | Highest; lowest; ratio | Branch | Daily usage |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10, 14, 20 | 20; 10; 2.0 | 1.4 or more | 20 divided by 30: 0.666667 |
| 20, 24, 28 | 28; 20; exactly 1.4 | 1.4 or more | 28 divided by 30: 0.933333 |
| 20, 22, 24 | 24; 20; 1.2 | 1.15 or more, below 1.4 | 24 plus 22 (one third of 66) is 46, halved is 23, divided by 30: 0.766667 |
| 20, 21, 23 | 23; 20; exactly 1.15 | 1.15 or more, below 1.4 | 23 plus 21.333333 is 44.333333, halved is 22.166667, divided by 30: 0.738889 |
| 20, 21, 22 | 22; 20; 1.1 | neither | not re-sized |
| 0, 10, 20 | a month without net vends | neither | not re-sized |

Both lower bounds include equality: a highest month of exactly 1.4 or exactly 1.15 times the lowest falls in the branch it opens.
